title: Template kit: ?page=, ?paged= and /page/N/ result pages are pagination links, and a rebuild keeps fullShotOf
steps: S1: Run fixedLinkLabels on a kit whose listing page has a link "2" to /donations?page=2, /news?paged=2 or /blog/page/2/ (the result page is also a kit page).
S2: Run keepFullShots on a rebuilt kit with the previous kit's pages naming fullShotOf.
expect: S1: the link carries the fixed label rule "pagination" (no link-label error).
S2: each rebuilt page has the previous page's fullShotOf.
evidence: JA Impact: the pagination link 2 on Donations and Events was reported as a link-label error; JA Morgan: a rebuild lost fullShotOf
fence: Pure functions of the kit tool read on made-up kits
